title: Fence remote project POST responses against authority drift
outcome: Both remote project creation and lazy ensure_remote_project_binding release application state while POST /api/projects is in flight, then persist the response without proving that the project/remote routing authority is still the one that issued the request. Concurrent remote removal or endpoint replacement can attach an old server project id to a missing/new endpoint, and lazy binding can overwrite a concurrent project rebind. Revalidate the captured project identity and routing config under the final state lock, reject stale responses without mutation, and add deterministic removal, endpoint-replacement, and rebind coverage for both paths.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Remote POST is fenced in ec2786c (ancestor of master f7db2c58); BINDING_CHANGED_DURING_CREATE in src/remote_*.rs. Closed by evidence.
